purpose: Approved high-frequency support words that may appear in Block 07 readers without needing Block 04 introduction, provided they are used only as grammatical scaffolding and not as lesson focus vocabulary.
usage_rules: Use this bank for function words and sentence-linking helpers only.
Do not use this bank to justify new content nouns, verbs, adjectives, or morphology-family examples that should be prepared in Block 04.
If a word carries the scene, action, or lesson meaning, it should come from current or prior Block 04 vocabulary, not this bank.
Inflected or derived lexical forms are not automatically approved just because their base form is common.
